versions.title: Group completion commutes with infinite products
versions.abstract: We show that group completion of 𝔼ₙ-monoids commutes with infinite products for n ≥ 2, by reducing the question to a more general theorem about the infinite-product-preservation of the realization functor on a suitable class of simplicial 𝔼₁-monoids. We also provide an alternative shorter argument specifically for the case of 𝔼∞-monoids, which uses the known fact that K-theory of additive ∞-categories commutes with infinite products.
versions.human_review: The main arguments have originally been generated through the use of generative AI, and then checked and simplified by the three authors.
